title: Facial-Cue Removal and Spectators’ Emotional and Aesthetic Experience in Sport: R1 analysis code and material inventory
description: Preparation version of survey/eye revision analysis code, aggregate results, and a stimulus asset inventory for manuscript 1960815. No raw participant observations or stimulus image binaries are included. The preserved B-task inventory contains 12 assets (six scene pairs), while the manuscript describes 12 base images each in two versions; reconciliation and source/redistribution material are pending. Archived fNIRS tables are not new original-Quest sensitivity results. MIT applies to software; photographs require separate applicable terms. This metadata file does not assert that a Zenodo record has been published.
